The most common win left on "EMERALD MINE 9X" is $5. The second biggest prize left is $10,000, and eight of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

If you play "EMERALD MINE 9X" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
5055.headline: What the prize table shows

5057.body:
"EASY MONEY" has 412,632 prizes of $2 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $10,000 prize, with two left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

The numbers for "EASY MONEY" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
5057.headline: The prize table, line by line

5059.body:
"THE CASH WHEEL" offers a top prize of $1 million and fourteen prize levels in all. The prize money leans toward small, frequent prizes. Games shaped like this pay out often, in small amounts. This design never changes, while every other number on this page does.

The table below shows the full count for "THE CASH WHEEL", with every prize level included.
5059.headline: The prize mix in this game

5060.body:
All the top prizes on "FIND THE 7S" have been claimed. That lowers the biggest prize from $50,000 to $10,000. Two of those are still out there. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

Today's free summary of "FIND THE 7S" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
5060.headline: Top prize already claimed

5063.body:
"CA$H IN HAND" is down to two top prizes after a $2 million winner was claimed two weeks ago. The game started with four top prizes. Know that before you buy, because a change in top prizes changes the whole game.

If "CA$H IN HAND" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
5063.headline: A top prize was just claimed
